question: Can colour-conditioned Gaussian hypervolume geometry transfer across disjoint species in geographic versus environmental representations, while independent species-specific structure is not miscalled commonness?
claim_boundary: Representation-specific synthetic predictive identifiability, not causal identification of climate versus geography. If E=f(G), a shared environmental response is also a geographic function. Both/neither outcomes must be retained. No observed biological colour values or real environmental rasters are used.

simulation.geography: Independent uniform unit-sphere photo locations, G=sqrt(3)*xyz; geography is 3D Cartesian embedding, not longitude-latitude Euclidean distance.
simulation.environment: A fixed smooth two-dimensional fourth-harmonic field E=(x^4-6*x^2*y^2+y^4, 4*x*y*(x^2-y^2))*sqrt(315)/8. It is synthetic, not CHELSA or an estimated biological environment. These even fourth-order coordinates create repeated environmental conditions with identical first/second geographic moments in the population.
simulation.colour: Binary synthetic labels sign(amplitude*random_species_sign*tanh(projection/0.5)+Normal(0,1)); species signs are arbitrary colour names and never used by the estimator.

worlds.geographic_shared: One random unit direction in G shared by every species.
worlds.environmental_shared: One random unit direction in E shared by every species.
worlds.geographic_specific: Independent random geographic direction for each species.
worlds.environmental_specific: Independent random environmental direction for each species.
worlds.mixed_specific: Each species independently selects geographic or environmental structure with probability 1/2, then its own independent direction.
worlds.confounded_shared: Separate positive control: E equals the first two geographic coordinates and every species responds to the first geographic coordinate. Predictive success in both representations must not be forced into an exclusive cause.

estimator.class_gaussian: Sample mean and sample covariance per species/class; covariance=(1-0.2)*sample_cov+0.2*trace(sample_cov)/dimension*I+1e-8*I; equal class priors.
estimator.total_volume: 95% Gaussian ellipsoid log-volume from all coordinates, without colour. This negative control must remain invariant to colour-label replacement on the same coordinates.
estimator.within_species_separation: 1 minus analytic Gaussian Bhattacharyya affinity of the two class distributions; not geometric ellipsoid intersection and not evidence of cross-species sharedness.
estimator.transfer: For each training species, fit its two class Gaussians and use equal-prior QDA to partition each evaluation species' photos. Average adjusted Rand index over all 30x30 ordered train/evaluation pairs. ARI makes whole-species label reversal irrelevant. No evaluation label is used to fit or tune a Gaussian.
estimator.low_information: Training or evaluation species with fewer than four examples in either synthetic class contribute zero transfer/separation score rather than being silently removed. Their fraction is reported. Predicted constant partitions also score zero.
estimator.repetition_unit: An entire simulated world, not the dependent species pairs or photos. No multiplier from repeated maps is interpreted as biological sample size.

calibration.rule: Separately at each amplitude and representation, use the maximum of the four independently calibrated 97.5th-percentile thresholds (higher order statistic). Report independent evaluation rejection rates and Wilson intervals. Threshold calibration uncertainty is not included in those intervals; nominal familywise 5% is a target, not certified by construction.
calibration.decision: Geographic score>geographic threshold; environmental score>environmental threshold. Preserve geography_only, environment_only, both, neither.
calibration.confounded_control: Calibrate separately using the same four nuisance definitions but E=G[:2]; freeze same counts, estimator and threshold rule. No causal label is assigned.
prohibited: changing observed G1 or environmental decisions

actual_geometry_audit.method: Verify export checksum, uniqueness and coordinate validity. Compare complete versus classifiable geometry for the same 369 eligible species using synthetic E only. Record coordinate covariance effective rank and 95% Gaussian log-volume; report the 131-species eligibility loss separately. Full-versus-retained raw volume comparison is descriptive and sample-size-confounded, not an unbiased missingness effect.
actual_geometry_audit.scope: Actual coordinate/mask audit only, not calibrated power for the actual RGFCA, not observed-colour niche inference, not a real climate test.
